mapper.sql: sl.id, sl.limit_id AS limitId, sl.material_id AS materialId, sl.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, sl.min_stock AS minStock, sl.max_stock AS maxStock, sl.warning_stock AS warningStock, sl.remark, sl.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: SELECT , m.material_name AS materialName, w.node_name AS warehouseName, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(package_num) FROM spd_label WHERE material_id = sl.material_id AND warehouse_id = sl.warehouse_id AND del_flag = 0 AND label_status = 1), 0 ) + COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(remaining_num) FROM spd_bulk_material WHERE material_id = sl.material_id AND warehouse_id = sl.warehouse_id AND del_flag = 0), 0 ) AS currentStock FROM spd_stock_limit sl LEFT JOIN spd_material m ON sl.material_id = m.material_id LEFT JOIN spd_org_node w ON sl.warehouse_id = w.node_id WHERE sl.id = #{id} AND sl.del_flag = 0
